description: A parenthesized iterator name is an error
notes: The README's example gives the iterator as a bare name, and doesn't say how the iterator attribute is read, or whether parentheses around the name, which only group in evaluation, still give it. hashicorp/hcl reads the attribute with hcl.AbsTraversalForExpr (expandBody.decodeSpec in ext/dynblock/expand_spec.go), which can't see through the parentheses (see native/analysis/traversal-parenthesized).
reference_error: A single static variable reference is required
